error.invalid_auth: Thames Water rejected the username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Thames Water. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.not_smart_metered: That account has no smart meter, so Thames Water publishes no readings for it.
error.no_meters: The Thames Water account has no meters to read from.

abort.invalid_auth: Thames Water rejected the session before an account could be selected.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Thames Water while loading the account. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
abort.not_smart_metered: This login has no smart-metered account, so there are no readings to fetch.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Fetches older readings and writes them into the consumption statistics. Re-running it is safe: a reading already written is overwritten with the same value.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first day to import. Readings exist from before you moved in, so a start earlier than your move-in date imports the previous occupant's usage.
